notes.subject: קרבו פקודות העיר
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS: 'Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near' (imperative) vs YLT/BSB: 'the executioners/inspectors of the city have drawn near' (perfect) — Sesotho text follows the imperative reading.

notes.subject: פקודות
notes.rationale: פקודה ke 'etelo' kapa 'tsebe ya kahlolo'; 'ba etelang kahlolo' — eseng feela 'ba tlametseng'.

notes.subject: ba etelang kahlolo
notes.rationale: Qapi e hlokahalang bakeng sa ketsahalo, e emetse ⟨את⟩ toro e hlalosang se etswang sona.

notes.subject: קרבו
notes.rationale: Taelo e hlahlamang — bitso la bona le bitlang ba phemelo hore ba tlalehe torong.

translation: Mme o ile a bitla lethoding la ka ka modumo o moholo, a re: Tlalehang, ba etelang kahlolo ⟨את⟩ toro; mme mong le mong ka sebetsa sa phemelo ya hae ka letsoho la hae.
